## 0.2.325

owes: a new collection on the wire — `notes.note_places` (the phone's manual note order in All notes, DataCore SPEC-018): the hub stores it per user, relays it to the owner's devices only and the engine's round names it; purging a note, from the Trash page or the 30-day sweep, tombstones its place in the same batch. No migration (the store holds any well-formed collection); a place orphaned by an earlier purge stays, ignored. SyncCore re-pinned from 0.10.44 to 0.10.46 and DataCore from 0.6.21 to 0.6.25 (the one consumer line is the new collection); Tooling from v0.1.75 to v0.1.77 (submodule, `preflight`, `finish` and `repin` action refs): nothing ships from it. Nothing to do.
